title: Search My Items
description: Mod that adds container searching system, to improve minecraft's looting expirience
body:
![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1396722/description_c33f5a50-c716-4f1a-92dd-d8c46867cb7e.png) Search My Items 🔎✨ Search My Items is a mod that adds a simple (but super immersive) mechanic: you must “search” items inside containers before you can fully access them. Any container that spawns with a loot table will require searching — turning looting into a more realistic scavenging experience 🧰😄By holding torch in your hand or off-hand you can speed up the process of searching, you can also speed it up by having night vision effect applied on yourself.

***

✅ **What does it affect?**

This includes all loot-table generated containers, such as:

🧱 Chests in structures (villages, dungeons, temples, etc.)

🪵 Barrels

📦 Any other loot-table based containers supported by your modpack

***

⚙️ **Config Support**

The mod comes with a config file, so you can easily tweak the mechanic to fit your project:

🛠️ Adjust how searching works

⏱️ Change difficulty / pacing

🎮 Make it more hardcore or more casual — your choice

***

🐛 **Issues / Bug Reports**

Found a bug or something feels off? No worries — report it here: Discord: nwkeyy 💬🧩

💡 **Suggestions Welcome!**

Got an idea for a feature or improvement? Tell me! I’m open to feedback and new implementations 🚀🔥

Thanks for using the mod & happy scavenging! 📦✨
